correctness.rationale: Over F2, the hybrid cyclic linear update is B_n=W(C_n)+E_00 (a self term only at site 0). The cycle characteristic determinant z p_{n-1}(z) and the diagonal cofactor p_{n-1} give chi_B=(z+1)p_{n-1}. The path recurrence p_k=z p_{k-1}+p_{k-2} and Frobenius when n=2^s m with m odd show p_{n-1}=z^(2^s-1)*p_{m-1}^{2^s}, p_{m-1}(0)=1. For even n the equations Bx=0 have a one-dimensional nullspace, hence exactly one nilpotent zero-Jordan block of length q=2^s-1; for odd n the map is invertible. Fitting decomposition counts initially periodic and exact first-entry shells as powers of two; uniform Rule90 has the two size-2^(s-1) nilpotent chains. Independently recomputed F2 matrix-power ranks for n=3..25, matching full profile; the all-n result follows algebraically, not by rank sampling.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Lettieri et al 2006 general minimal-polynomial machinery can yield transients after computing this hybrid characteristic and Jordan form, but its tabulated Rule90/Rule150 results are the two homogeneous extremes and do not themselves imply the one-site defect valuation formula. General nonuniform CA frameworks (Dennunzio et al) do not give this specific cyclic all-state census.

originality.rationale: Full-text examination of Lettieri-Stevens-Thomas (2006) shows Section 4 treats homogeneous Rule 150 T=W+I and its period lengths relative to homogeneous Rule90, not a *single exceptional site* W+E00. Section 3 contains path/cycle polynomial identities and transient algebra used as premises. Dennunzio et al broad non-uniform CA formalism is mostly bi-infinite; exact all-n finite cyclic one-site shell populations were not found. The new result is the hybrid defect Jordan structure and first-entry distribution, not general Fitting machinery or the known homogeneous tables.
